dogecoin.text:
Dogecoin pumps cause Elon's bored again  
Solana memecoins? Pure chaos, zero chill  
Vitalik's AI dreams got us hyped but broke  
TRUMP coins? Dumped by lunch, classic scam  
Web3's future? Maybe, if you dodge the rugpulls 🫠

Yo, $PENGU mooning at $0.03 while $DOGE rides Elon's hype train.  

NFTs pumping like it's 2021, but $TRUMP? Just another pump-and-dump scam.  

Web3 shills screaming AI and Layer2, yet we're all just chasing memes.  

Wake up, crypto bros - stop FOMOing into Vitalik's dreams.
